primary_text_inspection.title: Rahman et al. 2015, Suspension feeding in the enigmatic Ediacaran organism Tribrachidium
primary_text_inspection.inspection: Read primary morphology sections: three raised curved counterclockwise branches, bullae, shallow apical pits, fossil scale/relief, and uncertainty of affinities. Opened actual fossil panels A/B from the consult-only pixel file; did not treat latex-cast C/D scans as the chosen visible form.

primary_text_inspection.title: NPS, Nunataks, Arêtes, and Horns
primary_text_inspection.inspection: Read NPS landform distinction and compared actual Garden Wall NPS photo: thin jagged crest, steep sides, low cols, elongated ridge rather than compact pyramidal horn.

primary_text_inspection.title: Izumida et al. 2017, Kinu crevasse splay study
primary_text_inspection.inspection: Read primary summary/limitations and opened actual Fig. 3 orthophoto and DSM pixels. Source explicitly concerns a breached artificial levee and disaster/floodplain context, so candidate is bounded as generic educational morphology, not site copy or natural-levee validation.

primary_text_inspection.title: DOE/GSA 2014 final report, Fig. 18
primary_text_inspection.inspection: Read source text distinguishing long systematic face cleats from shorter, near-orthogonal butt cleats terminating at intersections; opened actual Fig. 18 vertical and bedding-plane outcrop panels. Figure is credited as modified from Pashin et al. 2008 and remains consult-only.
